data.narrative:
Emerald AI is a seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Varun Sivaram that has raised $68M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a broader comp universe of 9 private-sector peers in Climate & Energy, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, alongside one public comparable (LNZA). However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables at similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach; only one quantitative method is therefore applicable.

Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $68M raised as a valuation proxy, applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in venture equity. This yields an implied valuation of $170M. No alternative triangulation method produced sufficient data coverage to refine or validate this result independently.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, with a median estimate of $170M. This range reflects limited methodological redundancy and material uncertainty around peer comparability in an early-stage, emerging-technology sector where transaction multiples and staging conventions remain heterogeneous. Key uncertainties include the company's actual revenue or deployment metrics relative to later-stage peers, the timing and terms of the next funding round, and sectoral multiple compression or expansion driven by energy market cycles and policy shifts.
